description: This setting allows you to scan excluded files and directories during quick scans.

options.displayName: If you set this setting to 0 or do not configure it, exclusions are not scanned during quick scans.
options.description: If you set this setting to 0 or do not configure it, exclusions are not scanned during quick scans.

options.displayName: If you set this setting to 1, all files and directories that are excluded from real-time protection using contextual exclusions are scanned during a quick scan.
